name: Neymar Jr
bio: Brazilian forward known for his exceptional dribbling skills and playmaking ability. A key player for Brazil in international competitions.

name: Vinícius Jr
bio: Explosive winger with incredible pace and technical ability. Rising star who has become one of Brazil's most important attacking threats.

name: Rodrygo
bio: Versatile forward capable of playing on either wing or as an attacking midfielder. Known for his intelligent movement and finishing.

name: Raphinha
bio: Skillful winger with excellent crossing ability and set-piece expertise. Provides creativity and width to Brazil's attack.

name: Casemiro
bio: Defensive midfielder known for his tactical intelligence, ball-winning ability, and leadership. The engine room of Brazil's midfield.

name: Lucas Paquetá
bio: Creative midfielder with excellent vision and technical skills. Capable of playing in multiple midfield roles.

name: Bruno Guimarães
bio: Box-to-box midfielder with great energy and passing range. Adds dynamism and control to Brazil's midfield.

name: Marquinhos
bio: Versatile defender who can play center-back or right-back. Known for his leadership, aerial ability, and tactical awareness.

name: Thiago Silva
bio: Experienced center-back with exceptional positioning and reading of the game. Veteran leader in Brazil's defense.

name: Éder Militão
bio: Strong and athletic defender comfortable in both center-back and right-back positions. Excellent in aerial duels.

name: Alisson
bio: World-class goalkeeper known for his shot-stopping ability and distribution. One of the best keepers in world football.

name: Ederson
bio: Goalkeeper with exceptional distribution and long-range passing. Known for his ability to start attacks from the back.

name: Gabriel Martinelli
bio: Young and energetic forward with great dribbling skills. Rising talent who brings pace and directness to Brazil's attack.

name: Gabriel Jesus
bio: Hardworking forward with excellent pressing and movement. Versatile attacker who can play across the front line.

name: Bremer
bio: Strong center-back with excellent defensive positioning. Emerging talent in Brazil's defensive options.

name: Danilo
bio: Versatile full-back capable of playing on both sides. Experienced defender with good crossing ability.
